title: nf-WGS-QC pipeline parameters for alignment QC
description: Whole genome sequencing quality control pipeline.

input_bam.description: A samplesheet TSV file describing the alignment files (bam or cram)

somalier_vars.description: A VCF file containing variants set to be used with somalier

mosdepth_precision.description: Precision level when writing mosdepth coverage statistics

mosdepth_per_base_coverage.description: Compute mosdepth per base coverage. When active this slows down computation significantly

mosdepth_thresholds.description: Coverage targets for which to report regions fraction of bases

mosdepth_quantize_bins.description: Activate mosdepth quantized outputs and define the coverage bins

mosdepth_quantize_labels.description: Define custom labels for the quantized bins. When provided must match the numbers of configured bins

qrs_subset_reads.description: Number of reads to subset when computing quick reads stats
